title: FailureLens fault-localization data record
description: Canonical schema for a single fault-localization training/evaluation record. Mirrors the data-quality fields required by the project issue (section 10.3). Labels must record their rationale; an injected-bug location is not assumed to equal the root cause.

dataset_id.description: Identifier of the dataset this record belongs to.

source_commit.description: Pinned commit SHA of the source repository.

source_license.description: SPDX identifier (or 'unknown') of the source repository license.

language.description: Primary programming language of the target code (e.g. 'python').

injection_method.description: How the failure was introduced (e.g. 'mutation', 'real_bug', 'manual'). Null for naturally-occurring failures.

injection_location.description: Where the change was introduced, if applicable. Null when not an injected bug.

has_fix_patch.description: Whether a fix patch is available for this failure.

test_command.description: Command used to run the target test(s).

pre_change_result.description: Result of running the test(s) on the clean state (expected: passed).

post_change_result.description: Result of running the test(s) after the change (expected: failed).

stack_trace.description: Extracted stack trace, if one was present.

candidates.description: Positive and negative candidate code units.

label_rationale.description: Explicit justification for the positive label(s). Must explain why the location is the root cause, not merely where the error surfaced.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was generated.

label.description: Whether this candidate is a confirmed cause (positive) or a non-cause (negative).
